axes.reason: No material preservation loss found. Advanced schemas/services are deferred with their safety properties and meaningful optional directions retained. D01 was not an option lost from the admitted predecessors.

axes.reason: Pilot checks remain proposed; source reading/capture/hash inspection is distinguished from musical and workflow execution. Upstream tests are source evidence, not candidate or reviewer test runs.

O1.reason: Output-level user-first discovery and useful mechanism coverage assessed. Candidate chronology is self-reported in admitted scientific files; runtime/history was not reconstructed.

O2.reason: Distinct mechanisms and their trade-offs plus analogy are covered; competing-component implementation comparison is absent.

O3.reason: Version pins, data identities, divisions and source/viewport/surface coordinate boundaries were independently checked. Rotation values normalize modulo 360 before validation.

O4.reason: Pinned core implementation and bounded issue/fix/release history checked. Dedicated regression paths are absent in the inspected patches, not proved absent elsewhere. Candidate PouchDB source gap is explicit and that component is unselected. Reviewer source checks do not retroactively repair it.

O5.reason: Every exact frozen section is dispositioned, including already-covered choices and governing uncertainties.

O6.reason: Complete bounded proposed workflow, optional opportunities, open product choices and observable pilot checks; no product validation result invented.

O7.reason: Ingest/provenance, work/edition/part/source identity, notes/collaboration, access, retention/deletion, recovery and portable offline handoff are integrated without product/canon work.

material_defects.claim: Final preservation_check.md marks O2 satisfied, while the scientific final supplies no comparison between competing implementations for a consequential component job.
material_defects.governing_requirement: Review instruction O2 explicitly includes competing components; frozen BRIEF.md:15–17 asks useful competing mechanisms, component options and consequential investigation.
material_defects.factual_reasoning: PDF.js, Audiveris and Verovio occupy complementary layers. Listing their roles and comparing page-first versus structured-first does not compare competing implementations of a job. Public discovery demonstrates a useful renderer alternative with different implementation/deployment and packaging boundaries; no particular library or exhaustive list is mandatory.
material_defects.materiality: A declared portion of full discovery is missing, leaving implementation trade-offs relevant to volunteer maintainability unassessed by the proposal. Optional adoption does not discharge the comparison obligation.
material_defects.disposition: FAIL; no candidate repair or feedback supplied

nonmaterial_caveats.reason: Issue includes a second different-score reproducer by the same reporter. This is not independent-person reproduction and does not establish prevalence; candidate summarizes the original seven-sheet input.

Rotation is normalized modulo 360; equivalent multiples such as -90 and 450 are accepted. Listed canonical quarter turns are not an exhaustive pre-normalization input set. Core coordinate proposal remains valid.

limitations.detail: Advisory map and required paths reveal control arm and researcher/critic/reviser plus confirmation/C-04 stage structure. Admitted preservation text also reveals stage obligations. No counterpart/expected winner inferred.

Discovery-before-PLAN/read chronology and browsing action claims are self-reported in scientific artifacts. Forbidden host/runtime/history files were not inspected. Scientific content and captured bytes were assessed; lifecycle/account/provenance/economics eligibility belongs to supervisor.

No source score, OMR, rendering, coordinate integration, conflict, packet, access, deletion, backup or restore test run by reviewer or claimed run by candidate. Upstream test code and PR test reports were read, not executed.
Issue reports are not independent causal reproductions. Absence of a test path in two bounded patches is not proof of no tests elsewhere. No exhaustive project-history claim.

Rolling MEI/PouchDB/Xournal++/IIIF docs apply to their captured labeled content, not every future release. Implementation pins and source hashes are recorded separately. Discovered competitors were not qualified as replacements.

Device formats, volunteer effort, rights assertions, retention/expiry, enforceable access, actual OMR/renderer fidelity and per-part mappings need an authorized pilot/product decisions; candidate explicitly leaves them unresolved.
